result.description: The Trustee for Mirvona Dairies Trust  Position:  Dairy Farmer   Company:  Mirvona Dairies   Location:  Jamberoo NSW 2533   Salary:  $79,500.00 + Superannuation (Annual)   Job Type:  Full time       Position Summary   This role is responsible for planning, organising and managing the operation of the dairy herd enterprise at Mirvona Dairies – breeding, raising and maintaining the health and productivity of the dairy herd and calves. The Dairy Farmer sets herd health, breeding and production strategy, manages the associated budget and purchasing decisions, and supervises farm staff involved in herd operations. The role carries genuine decision-making authority over day-to-day herd management, reporting outcomes and strategic recommendations to the Farm Owner. It requires sound business judgement, strong technical knowledge of dairy herd management, and the ability to lead a small team while remaining hands-on where required.      Responsibilities    Plan, organize and manage the operation of the dairy herd enterprise, including breeding, health, nutrition and production programs, to meet farm performance and productivity goals.  Set herd health, breeding and production strategy and targets – including conception rate, pregnancy rate, lameness reduction and somatic cell count – and take ownership for achieving them, reporting outcomes and recommendations to the Farm Owner.  Develop and manage the budget for herd health, breeding and nutrition programs, including forecasting costs and approving purchasing decisions for veterinary services, vaccines, feed supplements and treatment programs within budget.  Select, train and supervise farm staff involved in herd health, milking, and calf rearing, including allocating daily tasks and providing performance feedback.  Oversee the purchase, sale and transport of livestock, including negotiating terms with suppliers and service providers, and ensuring health documentation and compliance requirements are met.  Collect, analyses and act on herd data using farm management systems (including DairyComp 305 and Datamars) to drive continuous improvement in herd strategy and inform management decisions.  Make independent, judgement-based decisions on herd health protocols, treatment plans and biosecurity measures, escalating only complex cases requiring veterinary intervention.  Recommend and implement improvements to farm systems, protocols and infrastructure based on data analysis and operational outcomes.  Direct and oversee daily monitoring of herd health, condition scoring and early disease detection, ensuring prompt preventative and curative treatment across the herd.  Manage breeding operations including heat detection, mating, pregnancy diagnosis, synchronization protocols, and calving support.  Oversee milking operations, including technique, hygiene protocols, and equipment maintenance, to achieve milk quality KPI targets such as somatic cell counts, bacteria levels, and milk composition.  Oversee routine husbandry tasks including drenching, vaccination programs, parasite control, and biosecurity measures.  Oversee nutritional management programs including pasture assessment, supplement distribution, and feed quality monitoring.  Maintain detailed, audit-defensible records of animal treatments, conditions, and outcomes, and report on herd performance against targets.  Manage calf health and rearing programs including colostrum management, disease prevention, and weaning protocols.  Respond to emergency herd health situations and provide first aid; escalate cases requiring veterinary intervention promptly.  Ensure fences, water supply systems, and facilities are maintained to provide a safe, healthy animal environment.  Lead biosecurity protocols and disease prevention programs across all farm sites.  Contribute to a positive, safe, and operationally efficient farm culture.       Skills     Dairy Herd Management – Extensive experience managing herd health, breeding, nutrition, production performance, and animal welfare to achieve productivity targets.   Leadership & Staff Supervision – Ability to train, supervise, and coordinate farm staff, allocate workloads, and foster a safe and productive working environment.   Data Analysis & Farm Management Systems – Proficient in analyzing herd performance data using farm management software (including DairyComp 305 and Datamars) to support informed decision-making and continuous improvement.   Livestock Health & Biosecurity Management – Strong knowledge of disease prevention, treatment protocols, biosecurity measures, calf rearing, and emergency herd health response.   Operational Planning & Budget Management – Skilled in developing herd health, breeding, and nutrition programs, managing operational budgets, overseeing livestock transactions, and ensuring compliance with industry standards and farm objectives.       About you     Relevant bachelor’s degree  5 years + of relevant work experience       Why join us   Join Mirvona Dairies and be part of a progressive dairy operation where your expertise will make a real impact. Enjoy a leadership role with genuine responsibility, modern farm systems, and the opportunity to contribute to a productive, supportive, and safety-focused team.  About Company     Mirvona Dairies  is a dairy farming business based in Jamberoo, New South Wales, specialising in the production of high-quality milk through the management of a productive and well-maintained dairy herd. The business is committed to best-practice dairy farming, with a strong focus on animal welfare, herd health, breeding, nutrition, and sustainable farming practices. Mirvona Dairies operates modern farm management systems and is dedicated to maintaining high standards of milk quality, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement. About CALHN
At Central Adelaide (CALHN), we're shaping the future of health through excellence in clinical care, research, and innovation. As South Australia's largest health network, we deliver exceptional, safe and connected healthcare - for our patients, our community, and our people.

With more than 17,000 dedicated employees, every day at CALHN presents an opportunity to make a real impact-not because it's expected, but because our values guide us to be our best. Find out more about CALHN sites and services, our stories and the opportunities to be part of CALHN.

About the Role

Support vital health research by keeping grants on track from award to close. You will manage records, build trusted links with researchers and partners, and keep grant data accurate, timely and compliant across CALHN.

- Manage grant records pre and post award
- Maintain clear, accurate data and files
- Liaise with researchers and CALHN teams
- Support reporting and funding queries
- Engage with SA Health, funders and partners

About You

You bring calm, care and clarity to complex admin work, and enjoy supporting research teams to succeed.

- Strong admin skills, work well solo or with others
- Sharp eye for detail, meet deadlines under pressure
- Clear written and verbal communication with diverse groups
- Confident with Microsoft Office and data systems
- Knowledge of grants, research governance or finance admin processes

Paid leave - with leave loading for rest and recharge

We're committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels safe, respected, and supported. We strongly encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, people with disabilities, culturally diverse backgrounds, and LGBTQIA+ communities.

result.description: A & M Packaging Pty Ltd  A & M Packaging Pty Limited is a leading Australian provider of flexible packaging solutions, committed to quality, innovation, and operational excellence. We provide comprehensive services ranging from packaging design and lamination to conversion and distribution. We are currently seeking a highly skilled Quality Engineering Officer to join our team and drive technical optimization across our manufacturing operations.  The Quality Engineering Officer will play a critical role in optimizing our packaging production lines and manufacturing technologies. You will be responsible for analysing system performance, implementing process improvements, and ensuring that our manufacturing workflows operate at peak efficiency, quality, and compliance. This role bridges the gap between production and engineering, requiring a hands-on approach to technical troubleshooting, equipment validation, and data-driven continuous improvement.   Benefits   Task & responsibilities   Evaluate manufacturing lines and equipment performance to pinpoint opportunities for increasing productivity, efficiency, and product quality.  Conduct root cause analysis on equipment failures and process anomalies, implementing engineering-based solutions to restore and enhance operational reliability.  Formulate and execute process improvement strategies aimed at maximizing resource utilization and reducing operational waste.  Assess production methods against established technical specifications and engineering standards to ensure all manufacturing processes remain within defined parameters.  Provide hands-on technical guidance and troubleshooting for production machinery and process technologies to mitigate downtime and boost system output.  Design, refine, and enforce technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and process controls to maintain consistency in production outcomes.  Partner with production, quality, and engineering teams to streamline packaging systems and refine manufacturing workflows.  Participate in the commissioning, testing, and validation of new manufacturing assets to ensure they meet performance and engineering benchmarks.  Develop and oversee testing and inspection protocols to verify process capability and maintain rigorous product performance standards.  Analyse production metrics and performance data to identify operational trends, supporting the implementation of continuous improvement projects.  Assist in the maintenance of operational and quality management frameworks to ensure alignment with industry regulations and internal business requirements.  Track the success of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), evaluating the impact of implemented solutions and recommending further technical upgrades where needed.    Qualification & experience   A tertiary qualification (Bachelor’s degree or Higher) in Engineering, Engineering Technology, or a related technical discipline.  Proven professional experience in a manufacturing, packaging, or industrial processing environment.  At least 3 years of professional experience in a similar role.  Solid understanding of engineering principles, production workflows, and manufacturing process controls.  Proficiency in utilising ERP systems (e.g., SAP or Microsoft Dynamics 365) for production data analysis and operational monitoring.  Demonstrated ability to conduct root cause analysis, troubleshoot equipment issues, and implement effective engineering solutions.  Excellent communication skills, with the ability to provide technical guidance and collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.   About Company    A & M Packaging Pty Limited is a leading Australian manufacturer and supplier of flexible packaging solutions, specializing in high-performance lamination, conversion, and distribution services across the country. We partner with a diverse range of industries to deliver consistently high standards of manufacturing quality, technical precision, and operational efficiency.  With a strong commitment to engineering excellence and service, we provide tailored packaging solutions designed to meet the complex technical requirements of each client. Our business places significant emphasis on process innovation, workplace safety, and continuous improvement to ensure our production systems are highly efficient, reliable, and performance-driven.  At A & M Packaging, our team members are dedicated professionals who take pride in their technical expertise and contribute directly to the innovation and operational success of our manufacturing operations. Experience managing advertising campaigns within regulated industries

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Employment Type: Temporary Full Time; 38 hours per week up to 12 months
Position Classification: Registered Nurse
Remuneration: $1,521.09 - $2,135.50 per week + annual leave loading + Superannuation
Located in: Concord Repatriation General Hospital
Requisition ID: REQ675617

In Sydney Local Health District our vision is Excellence in health and healthcare for all. You will be working in an innovative district that celebrates and invests in the ideas of staff, values people and offers life-long careers. Join the team at one of the leading public health organisations in Australia!

About the Role
The Concord Haematology Department delivers world-class tertiary Haematology clinical care, supported by active clinical, translational, and basic research. As one of the largest Haematology Clinical Research Units in NSW, we have recruited over 1000 patients to more than 140 trials since 2005.

Our Clinical Research Unit is led by Dr Nicole Wong Doo (Director) and Jennifer Harman (Manager). Our unit is staffed by a Clinical Coordination Division of five Registered Nurses and five Clinical Research Coordinators, all with tertiary science qualifications. Our highly skilled Business Operations Division efficiently meet our regulatory and reporting obligations, and support the team in various high-level administrative functions, in clinical trials governance and financial management. Ten haematologist investigators are supported by several clinical research fellows.

Our broad portfolio with 28 currently recruiting trials and 32 trials in follow-up is particularly strong in trials in lymphoproliferative diseases. As a national leader in accessing emerging therapies, our unit has a high proportion of patients referred for clinical trial participation both within Sydney and across NSW and ACT.

In this role you will be required to:

Assist with patient assessment for clinical trial eligibility, supporting recruitment activities and providing clear information to patients regarding trial requirements and treatments.

Coordinate and conduct patient study visits, including arranging and performing diagnostic investigations within scope of practice.

Maintain accurate and timely documentation in eMR systems and ensure clinical trial data is up to date across all required databases (Self training on databases is required within the scope of the role).

Coordinate the collection, processing, storage, and transport of pathology specimens in accordance with protocol and regulatory requirements. Adequate training will be provided. 

Liaise with multidisciplinary teams to ensure required clinical data is available for data entry and central review.

Participate in and coordinate monitoring visits with external sponsors, pharmaceutical companies, and research organisations.

Ensure accurate recording and maintenance of clinical trial data to meet Sydney LHD and study-specific contractual obligations.

Undertake primary responsibility for allocated clinical trials as both Lead and Backup Study Coordinator.

Act as the primary liaison and project coordinator for assigned studies, ensuring effective study conduct and stakeholder communication.
 

For more information, please view thePosition Description

Ideal Candidate

Current nursing registration with the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Australia (AHPRA).

Understanding of evidence informed practice and critical thinking.

Effective interpersonal skills, excellent written and verbal communication skills within a multidisciplinary team.

Clinical Research-Clinical Trial experience is desirable.

Ability to work Mon-Fri shifts with the potential for occasional overtime, to meet Blood sampling requirements. Flexible working hours between 0700 - 1730hrs. 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 

 
Benefits and Perks!

Accrued Day Off each month, Paid Parental Leave & Annual Leave loading

Opportunity for extra tax savings through Salary Packaging and Novated Leasing. For more information visit SalaryPackagingPlus

Access to free courses, qualifications and coaching via Sydney Education

Access to confidential EAP counselling for staff and their families

Because we care about your health: Free annual influenza vaccination, discounted Fitness Passport membership, and free telehealth nutrition and wellness resources from qualified professionals.

The ability to use the Concord Hospital Staff Gym

For more information about other benefits, please visit SLHD Benefits

This recruitment may be used to create a talent pool for similar future roles (ongoing or temporary) that may arise over the next 18 months.

 

Working for Sydney Local Health District - NSW Health

This is a Category A position. To be employed by NSW Health you are required to provide evidence of vaccination to comply with the NSW Health Occupational Assessment, Screening & Vaccination against Specified Infectious Diseases Policy (PD2026_004). 

SLHD is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity and inclusion. Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people and people with disability are encouraged to apply for all internal and externally advertised positions. If you require assistance, please advise the contact person at the time of your application.

Stepping Up aims to assist Aboriginal job applicants by providing information about applying for roles within NSW Health. For more information, please visit: https:--www.steppingup.health.nsw.gov.au-

Sydney Local Health District is committed to implementing the Child Safe Standards.

To further connect with us, check us out on LinkedIn

For enquiries, please contact Palak Shukla on (02) 9767 3822 or email at palak.shukla@health.nsw.gov.au
